name: Custom Audit
summary: Draco — the lawgiver. Author a custom Tenable .audit file two ways: describe the check in plain English and Claude drafts valid Nessus checks, or build one field-by-field from the platform catalog — Windows config (registry, password/lockout/audit policy, user rights, service, REG_CHECK, WMI, PowerShell), Windows file-content (FILE_CONTENT_CHECK), and Unix/Linux/macOS (file, content, command, RPM, process, service). Live .audit preview, syntax validation, and auto-mapped framework references (NIST/PCI/HIPAA/CIS/ISO). Download a scan-ready .audit or a single check. NEW: seed a whole CIS benchmark from the built-in library (CIS Docker, Ubuntu, RHEL) and adjust controls in one prompt (e.g. “create a CIS Docker benchmark and tighten 5.x”).
